profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Capital One
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer @ Capital One

UMD Alumni with a dual bachelors degree in Computer Science and Finance.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Clarity | Risk-Tech

Card Decision Orchestrator | Card Tech
•	Contributed to the evolution of the decisioning system into an enterprise-grade platform, enabling adoption across multiple business use cases beyond credit card decisioning
•	Scaled the core decisioning platform for credit card acquisitions from ~100K to ~2M API requests per day

DoStudio- Decisioning UI Platform (Team Lead)
•	Team lead for DoStudio, the UI platform running in PROD, enabling use case teams to visualize, test, and troubleshoot decisions
•	Led DoStudio from initial proof of concept through full production readiness, deploying and maintaining the application across Dev, QA, UAT, and Prod environments
•	Designed and developed the frontend application and core features from the ground up using JavaScript, React, Vite, and Jest
•	Architected, provisioned and deployed the backend AWS infrastructure including Route 53, CNAME records, Application Load Balancers (ALB), IAM roles/policies, and Fargate clusters 
•	Designed and implemented the backend service in Go, building and maintaining 8 API endpoints
•	Implemented Redux Toolkit for centralized state management and Redux Toolkit Query (RTK Query) for client-side API caching
•	Developed client-side routing using React Router to support navigation and routing within the application
positions.insights: Go (Programming Language), Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +18 skills

positions.title: Associate Manager
positions.description:
Avenue Project - United States Postal Service
•	Led a team of 4 in marketplace integration initiatives while actively developing in Java (Spring)
•	Delivered status updates and served as the primary point of contact between the development team and clients
•	Collaborated closely with both the design team and the business team to ensure alignment with user stories and proper QA user testing scenarios
•	Organized, scheduled, and assigned tasks to team members to prepare for upcoming sprints

positions.title: Software Engineer II (Full Stack)
positions.description:
•	Enhanced marketplace service efficiency by implementing Redis for temporary storage and optimizing database performance through the utilization of indexes and connection pools
•	Developed and deployed multiple marketplaces (Google, eBay, Squarespace) by writing and deploying helm charts to Kubernetes clusters and monitoring microservices in Rancher
•	Created and implemented multiple schedulers with distinct functions, such as automating email sending and refreshing Oauth tokens
•	Wrote front-end code for the shipping history page, a prominent landing page, encompassing advanced functionalities such as sorting, filtering, and search capabilities
•	Developed key features for the new primary USPS label shipping application that generates $10 million+ in revenue per month

positions.title: Software Engineer I (Full Stack)
positions.description:
•	Utilized Typescript, React, and React-Query to create multiple new page designs and features for the web application
•	Developed and launched 7 services and 4 services independently
